info.syllabusName: Introduction to Tourism & Hospitality industry_Tổng quan ngành Du lịch & Khách sạn
info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
-Objective: To provide a basic understanding of the hospitality and tourism industry by tracing the industry's growth, development, issues facing, and future trends

-Description: The course addresses the tourism and hospitality industry's structure, scope, and measurement. The students will be exposed to the roles of industry business players and governments. This course addresses the knowledge and skill needed for students to understand the development of the hospitality and tourism industry and its challenges.
info.studentTasks:
- Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purposes

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online support from teachers and other students, and for practicing and assessment.

clos.loDetails: Describe the definition, charateristics of the hospitality and tourism industry
Identify future trends in the hospitality and tourism industry (Chapter 10-13)
Describe and classify different hotel businesses
Identify main duties and responsibilities of the room division function (operations)
Describe the duties and responsibilities of the food and beverage function (operations)
Classify wine, beer, spirits, nonalcoholic beverages and describe bar & beverage operations.
Classify and differentiate characteristics of the restaurant business
Describe restaurant operations and its functional areas.
Outline and distinguish different managed services.
Explain the importance of tourism and describe key impacts on tourism organizations.
